seoTitle: Hide and Unhide Drawings & Indicators in TradingView
metaDescription: Learn how to use the eye icon on TradingView to hide or unhide chart drawings and indicators like moving averages without deleting them.
intro: Sometimes you want to temporarily hide drawings or indicators on a TradingView chart without deleting them entirely. This guide covers using the eye icon to toggle visibility for both your drawings and indicators like moving averages.

steps.heading: Open your chart
steps.body: Navigate to the chart tab on TradingView to open your default or saved chart layout.

steps.heading: Locate the eye button for drawings
steps.body: Find the eye icon on the lower left side of the chart, which controls visibility for your drawings.

steps.heading: Unhide drawings
steps.body: Click the eye button to reveal all previously hidden drawings and annotations on your chart.

steps.heading: Locate the eye button for indicators
steps.body: Find the eye icon associated with a specific indicator, such as a moving average, in the indicator list.

steps.heading: Unhide the indicator
steps.body: Click its eye icon to make the hidden indicator reappear on your chart.

steps.heading: Hide elements again when needed
steps.body: You can repeat these steps to hide drawings or indicators again whenever your chart feels cluttered.

faq.question: How do I unhide drawings on TradingView?
faq.answer: Click the eye icon on the lower left side of the chart to reveal all previously hidden drawings.

faq.question: Can I hide just one indicator without deleting it?
faq.answer: Yes, clicking the eye icon next to a specific indicator, like an SMA, toggles its visibility without removing it.

faq.question: Does hiding a drawing delete it?
faq.answer: No, hiding only affects visibility — the drawing or indicator remains saved until you choose to delete it.

faq.question: Why would I hide drawings or indicators?
faq.answer: It helps keep your chart organized and reduces distractions when you don't need to see every element at once.

faq.question: Can I unhide everything at once?
faq.answer: The main eye toggle can restore all hidden drawings at once, while indicators may need to be unhidden individually.
